description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to generating user and report data within the Mattermost server, including report options, date range calculations, and report formatting.

classes.name: ReportableObject
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be converted to report format.

classes.name: ReportingBaseOptions
classes.description: Struct for specifying base options for reports, including sorting, pagination, and date range.

classes.name: UserReportQuery
classes.description: Struct combining user data and post statistics for report queries.

classes.name: UserReport
classes.description: Struct representing a user report with detailed user information and post stats.

classes.name: UserReportOptions
classes.description: Struct for specifying options when generating user reports, including filters and sorting.

methods.name: GetReportDateRange
methods.description: Calculates start and end timestamps based on a specified date range string.

methods.name: PopulateDateRange
methods.description: Populates the StartAt and EndAt fields of ReportingBaseOptions based on current time and DateRange.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the date range and report options.

methods.name: ToReport
methods.description: Converts UserReportQuery or UserReport to report format.

methods.name: IsValidReportExportFormat
methods.description: Checks if a given report export format is valid.
